tagline: Copy on one device, use it on another.
description: Self-hosted clipboard and file bridge for Windows, Android, iPhone, iPad, and the browser. Stores shared text, photos, and files with searchable history and optional accounts.

tips.before_install: Use only on a trusted LAN or private VPN. Protection with `CLIPBOARD_PASSWORD` and `CLIPBOARD_TOKEN` is optional. Keep `/data` persistent and back it up before updates.

author: WisdomSky
